answer: Permissionless networks can block sybil swarms by forcing every account to submit a blind session receipt from an independent ISP line outside any cloud island, tied to the epoch seed hash within 500 ms of an audit check or burning 100% of a $30 lock bond. Honest solo agents use one home line for $1 monthly, sealing each epoch pearl on time under a strict 500 ms crystal window. Herding 1,000 fake accounts imposes a linear cost of 1,000 distinct ISP lines at $30,000 monthly, as shared subnets forfeit the bond. This fails if botnets lease hijacked home routers cheaply.
